entries.zh: 报知、告知；显明、表明（描画摹写）
entries.en: to notify, make known; to manifest, reveal; to trace/draw
entries.notes: 汉字栏「描」与其对音不尽吻合（疑涉「報」之形近异写），释义以西语栏 auisar/manifestar 为主。

entries.zh: 传报全社众人（通知全乡百姓、家家户户）
entries.en: to notify the whole town/community, all the households and people
entries.notes: 汉字栏「描家社甲」与西语 todo el pueblo 对应欠吻合，释义依西语栏。

entries.zh: 禀（向上司禀报请示）；禀帖
entries.en: to report to one's superior (requesting permission); to petition
entries.notes: 缩写 ssup. 展开「上司（superior）」系依推断；稟之本义自明。

entries.zh: 禀事（向上司禀报事务）
entries.en: to report a matter (to one's superior)

entries.zh: 词、词状（书面禀报之文）；词句、言词
entries.en: written report / statement submitted in writing; words, phrases

entries.zh: 呈（呈文上呈、呈报）；呈现
entries.en: to submit/present (a written report to a superior); to show

entries.zh: 落入人口、被人谈论（传到人们口中；授人口实）
entries.en: to fall into people's mouths; to be talked about, to give grounds for gossip
entries.notes: 西语栏文字欠通（疑残损），释义以汉字栏「落人口」为主。

entries.zh: 谨禀（恭敬禀报上司，书信套语）
entries.en: to respectfully report (to a superior); formal letter formula
entries.notes: 缩写 ssup. 展开「上司（superior）」系依推断。

entries.zh: 告禀（禀告、陈报上司）
entries.en: to announce and report (to a superior); to petition
entries.notes: 西语栏多系删汰残句（[删]），释义依汉字栏「告稟」。

entries.zh: 向敌人透露内情底细（泄露机谋、奸细告密）
entries.en: to tip off the enemy; to reveal one's innermost plans or secrets — treachery

entries.zh: 传报、报信（传话告知）
entries.en: to send word, transmit a report/message

entries.zh: 传说、口头传告（以言语相传）
entries.en: to spread word by mouth; to report verbally

entries.zh: 传给下手、传授门下（以教义教导后学）
entries.en: to pass on / instruct those under one, teaching with the Doctrine (catechism)
entries.notes: 「下手」作「门下后学/晚辈」解系推断；Dõtrina 展开为 Doctrina（教义/要理），西语栏句式残缺。

entries.zh: 传圣旨（宣读颁行诏旨、布告天下）
entries.en: to transmit/proclaim the imperial edict; to publish the sovereign's orders

entries.zh: 风向变动、岁节风向（报知年中风信）
entries.en: shifting of the seasonal winds; to give notice of the winds of the year (monsoon change)
entries.notes: 「動方」之「方」或为「風」之讹、或作「方位」解，释义综合西语栏「年中风向」定夺。

entries.zh: 摇动、动摇（心志不定、局面不稳）
entries.en: to shake, totter; to waver, vacillate
entries.notes: 西语栏 delsto inventa 难以解读（疑残损），释义依汉字栏「動搖」。

entries.zh: 未、尚未（还没有）
entries.en: not yet

entries.zh: 未闲、尚未得闲（还没有工夫、还不便）
entries.en: not yet at leisure; no room/opportunity for it yet

entries.zh: 现、现今；显现、现出
entries.en: now, at present; to appear, be manifest
entries.notes: 西语栏「+ aun.」（仍/尚）与汉字「現」（如今/显现）对应欠吻合，释义以汉字栏为主。

entries.zh: 现有、现下所有（还在、尚有）
entries.en: there still is / still has; at present available

entries.zh: 还（仍、尚）；归还、返还
entries.en: still, yet; to return, give back
entries.notes: 汉字「還」兼「仍旧/归还」两读：西语栏 aun 取「仍旧」义、音写栏作归还读，故两义并收。

entries.zh: 还未、还没有
entries.en: not yet; still not
